SYS_REMOTE_SUBSCRIPTIONS.description: Peers subscribed to a device of this board (SUBSCRIBE): each gets the device's events and errors. Another board's remote device takes one.

SYS_SESSION_CALLS.description: The board's own requests to other boards waiting for an answer (sys_session_call); a call to this board takes none. Every call to another board is answered, so each write of a remote device in flight takes one. A slot is about 52 B.

SYS_SESSION_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS.description: A call without an answer this long ends with ERR_SESSION_TIMEOUT, unless the caller gives its own. Longer than a radio's tail, so a slow answer is not taken for a lost one.

SYS_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS.description: A slave's session with nothing received for this long ends: its calls fail, its peers are gone, the hello starts again. The hello tells the peer, which sends at least every third of it. The master's and the clients' sessions take the dead-man's time instead (sys_session_set_timeout).

SYS_WATCH_MAX.description: Reads that peers added on this board (ADD), of every owner.

SYS_WATCH_CLIENT_MAX.description: Cached remote reads kept by the watch client (sys_watch_read).
